title: Measuring an agent: the eval harness that scores a released tag, not your tree
focus: An explainer of the new benchmarks/agent harness - it shells out to nanocoder --plain --json run so a published tag and the working tree can be compared with the same fixture set, it scores pass/fail, steps, tokens and cost per task, and its six vendored fixtures carry machine-checkable assertions plus distractor files so an agent working from degraded context fails the assertion instead of quietly finishing cheaper, with every result stamped with the fixture-set id and a content hash of the fixtures.
